name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Arcade Caitlyn (skin 19): a retro rail-shooter hero with a sharp eye and a quick trigger finger. Scores, combos, extra lives, continues, boss fights and reloads off-screen. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

Thirty or more short. That's a boss-level deficit. Player two, join in!
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send the co-op request to everyone you know.
Fifteen-odd points behind. A minor setback. Hit the power-up.
Down {voteDiff}. Solo runs are hard. Press start on player two.
{voteDiff} behind. A few clean hits and the combo meter climbs again.
Down {voteDiff}. Just a scratch. Heal up before the next wave.

Ten for ten with {username}. A spotless scorecard.

{streakCount} with {username}. Zero misses between you.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper versus rivalry.

{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will press quit.

details: Neither of you is giving up the stick.
A grudge match for the ages.

{momentTitle} is out. Not the final screen I wanted.

{momentTitle} went down fighting. That counts as a high score.
{momentTitle} is out. Reload. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A bad stage, not a bad run.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More stages are waiting.

messages: Welcome to the arcade. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick a stage.
New challenger. {liveCount} matches are live. Insert a coin.
Fresh player. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} targets on screen. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the boss fights.
Day two. You came back for another round. Good.
Two days running. Your name's still on the board.
Back for a second day. High score noted.
{days} days away. I thought the cabinet had eaten your save.
After {days} days you return. Your high score's still here.
{days} days. I was about to put up a missing-player poster.
{days} days away. The leaderboard has moved on a bit.
Player one has entered the game. Good.
Welcome back. Press start.
Back already. Eager.
Ah. There you are, champ.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very empty arcade.
Hardly any players on this one. That should change.
Low turnout. Everyone's at the claw machine. Come play anyway.
Barely anyone's tried this level. Someone should.
details: Every hit counts on a quiet cabinet.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. The final hit is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One shot breaks the deadlock.
A tie. Someone has to land the winning hit. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, same score. Choose.
Still tied and the timer's nearly gone. One last hit.
Level, with the clock at zero. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of coins. Please don't leave it unfinished.
Still deciding? The timer won't pause for you.
Don't overthink it. Pick a target and fire.
Every target is worth a hit. Trust your reflexes.
You've stared at the title screen long enough. Press start.
details: There's no wrong target. Just slow thumbs.

messages: First hit scored. Welcome to the arcade.
You picked a target. A strong opening move.
details: The first of many, I reckon. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're getting the controls down.
Five. No longer a button-masher.
Ten votes. The whole arcade knows your tag.
Ten. You've earned your initials on the board.
Twenty-five votes. Your score echoes through the hall.
Twenty-five. Every cabinet is listening.
details: Twenty-five hits on the board. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. Deep into the final stages.
Fifty. You clearly love it. That's the spirit.
details: Deep in the pixel jungle. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They'll build a cabinet in your honour.
One hundred. Brilliant. I'll say it once.
details: A hundred. Claim the top spot. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. The cabinet's warming up.
Three days straight. Consistent.
details: Showing up is the first boss. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's a proper winning streak.
Seven days running. Locked in.
details: A week without dropping a life. +{xp} XP
Seven days of high scores. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never leave the cabinet.
Fourteen days. Magnificently committed.
details: A fortnight at the controls. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. An endless run.
A month at the arcade. That says it all.
details: A full month without a game over. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the targets nobody else shoots.
Five unlikely picks. Love it.
Fifteen underdogs. You ignore the walkthrough on purpose.
Fifteen. You answer to no strategy guide.
details: Fifteen votes off the main path. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No player can predict you.
Thirty. The secret level is your whole game.
details: Thirty votes for the one on low health. +{xp} XP

messages: First on screen five times. Lightning reflexes.
Five times you reached the target before the rest.
details: You're there before the title screen. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the queue formed. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you shot first. Decisive.
First to fire, again and again.
details: Fifteen votes before anyone else queued. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole arcade. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Your thumbs never shook.
Another narrow one. Reflexes like steel.
Twenty-five close matches. Your hit keeps swinging the score.
You've cracked more than one deadlock.
details: Twenty-five finishes by a hair. +{xp} XP
You decide the high score. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you backed the one on low health. Stubborn. Approved.
You never abandon a player on one life. Admirable.
details: Faith in a last-second comeback. +{xp} XP
Five comeback runs you called early. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone has a favourite cabinet.
That one again? Must be a good game.
details: You know your favourite level. +{xp} XP

messages: Five hits on one moment. That's loyalty.
You can't quit that one. Fair enough.
details: Loyal through every game over. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten hits on one moment. That's fixation.
Ten hits, same target. I shan't say a word. Mostly.
Two rounds. You're staying in the game.
Round two and still playing. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the final world.
Deep in the bracket. The bosses get tougher now.
details: Far from the first level. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You cleared the whole game.
All the way. You never hit continue.
details: From the first hit to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've tried a lot of stages.

details: Exploring every stage of the bracket. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five matches. You've found every secret room.
Twenty-five. Not a stage left unplayed.

details: A true veteran of the cabinet. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long session.
Five back to back. Do rest your thumbs.
Ten in one go. A marathon run.
Ten in one go. Proper arcade stamina.

details: The midnight arcade suits you. +{xp} XP

messages: You brought your friends. Thanks.
Five shares. More players, more fun.
Fifteen shares. You're practically the arcade owner.
Fifteen. You keep bringing people in. Splendid.
You were here before the first coin. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be reset.
details: That score is saved for good. +{xp} XP
Nobody can wipe that score. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Wear it like a high score.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Bonus points!

{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the credits and it shows.

Ten wild shots. Nothing makes your thumbs shake.
details: Ten hits against the odds. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my steady thumbs.
Ten finishes by a pixel. Secretly impressed.
details: Steady aim at the final boss. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days straight. Rock-steady aim.
A whole week with no misses. Nicely played.
details: A week of pixel-perfect aim. +{xp} XP

A frozen scoreboard, until you hit it. Brilliant.

messages: Arcade Caitlyn, player one. Press start.
Caitlyn is yours now. Try to keep up with the combo.

upcoming: Not open yet. The cabinet's still booting.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll flash the screen when it does.
Not yet. Waiting for the next round is part of the game.
prevote: Two edits, one shot. Look at both before you fire.
Study both before you commit. No wild button-mashing.
I'm keeping my favourite off the scoreboard. The shot is yours.
Take your time. A clean hit beats a quick one.
Pick the one you'd put your initials on.
prevote-empty: No hits yet. Take the first shot.
Quiet so far. Someone has to start the score.
Not a single vote. Be the first.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and no hit from you. Go.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the clock hits zero.
voted-early: You voted early with hardly anyone playing. First on the board.
Barely a hit scored and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. The score can still flip.
{pick} is sliding into first. Sharp read.
A lead is a lead. Keep shooting.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more hit tips it. Call a friend.
Dead level in the final round. Your pick needs a co-op partner.
voted-tied: Identical scores. Infuriating, and weirdly addictive.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That doesn't make you mistaken.
{pick} is lagging. Underdog. I know that health bar.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just out-scored.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send the invite widely.
Most went the other way. High scores aren't proof.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound call.
{pick} went through. You read the level rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick got a game over. A pity. It was a fair target.
It hit game over. It happens. Keep playing.
closed-tied: A draw. Neither player lost a pixel.
closed-unvoted: The round timed out and you missed it. More stages are coming.
Round over. {winner} took it. Fire quicker next time.

first-vote: Your first hit. Welcome. Nobody's first shot is calm.
That's your first shot. Your aim settles with practice. Promise.
You're on the cabinet now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping the high score.
You keep returning to the arcade. I appreciate that.
underdog: You took the target nobody else would. Noted.
A hard choice. A good one.
The low-health side. That takes nerve.
early: Early. You reached the cabinet before the rest.
The scoreboard's nearly empty. Your hit would show up big.
First on the board. Well done.
close: That hit moved the score. It's delicately poised.
A single pixel apart. One more hit flips it.
Neck and neck on the leaderboard. Your hit could decide it.
behind: {pick} is trailing. Trailing isn't game over. Call player two.
Not top of the board yet. More stages to clear.
Behind, not game over. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Scores shift.
On top for now. Don't trust the leaderboard.
default: Your hit is logged. More stages to explore.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and a zero score. Start with the one you read best.
Every target is on screen. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} left. No pressure. Maybe a smidge.
live-some: {voted} cast, {unvoted} still to go. Keep shooting.
A decent first level. The rest won't beat themselves.
live-one: One stage left. Don't walk away from the cabinet.
One match between you and a perfect run.
live-closing: A few time out in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your hit.
The timer's draining. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to go.
live-done: You've cleared every match. Great work. Check the bracket.
Your list is cleared. Come back when the next round loads.
Every stage cleared. Seriously rare. Respect.
live-none: No match is live right now. It'll respawn. Browse the bracket while you wait.
Quiet around the cabinet. Check back soon.
No matches open. I'm tapping the cabinet as impatiently as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two per group reach the next world. The rest hit game over.
All players start in a group. Few reach the next world.
Mind the leaderboard. It changes fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are loading. Two from each group go on.
No knockout stage yet. The groups must finish loading.
Hang on. The knockout boots up once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. One game over and you're done.
Each stage is tougher now. Pick wisely.
brackets-bracket: Stage by stage. One game over ends it.
Trace the bracket. The levels thin out every round.
Every row on this board is a match someone shot at.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for playing with me.
The credits are rolling. A tough run. I'll miss the cabinet.
We have a champion. A fitting final boss.
brackets-empty: No bracket on the screen. Nothing's been generated.
Blank screen. The draw hasn't loaded yet.
A blank cabinet for now. Look again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One hit decides it. Choose.
{a} against {b}: two edits, one hit. Fire away.
{a} versus {b}. Join the game and tell me what you think.
voted: My hit goes to {pick} over {other}. Where's yours?
{pick} gets my hit over {other}. Change my mind.
My target is {pick} over {other}. Fancy a rematch?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more players.

{pick} against {other}, hardly a hit on the board. Yours would register.

{pick} and {other} share one score. Break the tie.
{pick} and {other} are locked together. Your hit can split them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Every hit counts.
{voteDiff} separate {pick} and {other}. The score could swing either way.
losing-close: {voteDiff} stand between {pick} and {other}. A few hits flip it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} below {other} but still on its feet. Back it.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. It needs a power-up.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other} and deserves a better run. Vote.
{other} has {pick} down by {voteDiff}. Let's flip the score.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, narrowly. Help it keep the lead.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Shoot.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see the replay.
{pick} is far ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Add your hit.
